chart.name: I/O latency (ms)
chart.programText:
A = data('sqlserver_database_io.write_latency_ms', filter=filter('plugin', 'telegraf-sqlserver'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('sqlserver_database_io.read_latency_ms', filter=filter('plugin', 'telegraf-sqlserver'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='B')

chart.name: Database wait conditions (ms)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('sqlserver_waitstats.wait_time_ms', filter=filter('wait_category', 'CPU', 'Worker Thread'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('sqlserver_waitstats.wait_time_ms', filter=filter('wait_category', 'Tran Log IO', 'Network IO', 'Other Disk IO', 'Buffer IO'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='B')
C = data('sqlserver_waitstats.wait_time_ms', filter=filter('wait_category', 'Lock'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='C')
D = data('sqlserver_waitstats.wait_time_ms', filter=filter('wait_category', 'Memory', 'Buffer Latch', 'OTHER', 'Latch', 'Preemptive'), rollup='delta').sum().publish(label='D')

chart.name: Database performance (ms)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('sqlserver_waitstats.wait_time_ms', rollup='delta').sum(by=['host.name']).mean().publish(label='A')
B = data('sqlserver_database_io.read_latency_ms')
C = data('sqlserver_database_io.write_latency_ms')
D = union(B, C).mean().publish(label='D')
E = data('sqlserver_performance.lock_wait_time').sum().publish(label='E')
F = data('sqlserver_performance.disk_read_io_sec').sum()
G = data('sqlserver_performance.disk_write_io_sec').sum()
H = (F+G).publish(label='H')
I = data('sqlserver_performance.number_of_deadlocks_sec').sum().publish(label='I')
